info.name: OCCTerm
info.summary: Run occ commands from a web terminal, as an administrator
info.description:
Run Nextcloud's `occ` maintenance commands from a browser terminal, without shell access to the server.
**This app executes occ as the web server user.** Anyone who can reach it can run any occ command, including ones that read and modify all user data. Enable it only when you need it.
It cannot run interactive or long-running commands. PHP gives Nextcloud no native support for asynchronous operations, so a command that prompts will hang and a command such as `files:scan` on a large instance will time out partway.
